title: Topological Neural Collapse
abstract: arXiv:2611.28894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural collapse (NC) predicts that, late in training, last-layer class features concentrate at their means and the means form a simplex equiangular tight frame (ETF). We ask whether NC also leaves a signature in the functional connectome of each layer: the graph of Pearson correlations between hidden-unit activations, built per class and summarized by persistent graph homology. Using deep MLPs, we observe two topological phenomena that co-occur with the well-studied geometric NC in the final layers during the terminal phase. Contrary to NC1, the split-half variability of a class connectome increases (TNC1). The mean pairwise $H_0$ distance $\bar{D}$ between class connectomes also rises (TNC2), but unevenly across class pairs, unlike the equidistance of NC2. We find that 24-56% of last-layer units become dead for some classes yet stay active for others, which inflates $\bar{D}$. After correcting for these units, both signatures remain e

translated_abstract: 神经坍缩预测，在训练后期，最后一层的类别特征会向其均值集中，且这些均值构成一个单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）。我们探究神经坍缩是否也在每层的功能连接组中留下印记：即隐藏单元激活之间的皮尔逊相关图，按类别构建，并用持久图同调加以概括。通过深度多层感知机的实验，我们观察到两个拓扑现象，它们在末期阶段与末层中已被充分研究的几何神经坍缩同时出现。与NC1相反，类别连接组的折半变异性反而增加（TNC1）。类别连接组之间的平均成对H₀距离 D̄ 也上升（TNC2），但其上升在类别对之间并不均匀，这与NC2的等距性不同。我们发现，24%–56%的末层单元对某些类别变得“死亡”，而对其他类别仍保持活跃，这推高了 D̄。在修正这些单元后，这两个特征依然存在。
tldr: 该论文首次将神经坍缩现象从几何层面拓展到拓扑层面，利用持久图同调分析各类别的层内功能连接组，发现训练末期存在两个与几何神经坍缩并行的新拓扑特征（TNC1：类别连接组折半变异性增加；TNC2：类别间平均H₀距离不均匀上升），并揭示24%–56%的末层单元存在类别特异性的“死亡”现象。
en_tdlr: This paper extends neural collapse from geometry to topology, using persistent graph homology on per-class functional connectomes to reveal two new late-training signatures—increased split-half variability of class connectomes (TNC1) and unevenly rising mean pairwise H₀ distances (TNC2)—partly driven by 24–56% of last-layer units becoming class-specifically dead.
